label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is baz = param (unsanitized user input from request.getParameter). The sink expression '<script>var msg="'+ baz +"';</script>' outputs baz directly to HTML without escaping. While bar is escaped via htmlEscape(), baz retains raw user input and flows unchanged to the HTML sink. This constitutes a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param flows to baz without escaping, then baz is written to HTML response sink
